'''Byllaya''' was an entity in the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] religion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. According to Doellinism, Byllaya was the enemy of the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Doellin]]. Byllaya was described as an endlessly [[Diet/Legends|hungry]] beast that worked to eat Kinyen's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were also known as the crops of Doellin. The Gran were protected from Byllaya by [[Taya]], the winged avatar of Doellin. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], most Gran viewed the myth of Byllaya as poetic rather than literal.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Byllaya was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
